subject: The 2AM preset I kept hidden
preview_text: I built an extra equalizer preset just for you — wasn't going to share it, but here it is.
body_paragraphs: Look, I wasn't planning to send this. Last Tuesday at 2AM, I was messing around with the equalizer in the app, trying to squeeze every drop of bass out of a track I'd been looping for hours. And I stumbled on something — a custom preset that made my phone sound like a club speaker.

I kept it to myself for a week. But then I thought, you're the kind of person who actually cares about sound — you didn't just download this app and forget it. You've been boosting your volume, tweaking things. So I saved it as a hidden preset in your app.

Open the equalizer and look for 'Midnight Boost' — it's there, right under the presets. It's designed for those moments when you're in a noisy room, your phone's at max, and you still can't hear the vocals or the bassline. It unlocks a clean 200% boost without distorting the mids.

Go check it now. Open Volume Booster - Sound Booster, tap the equalizer, and scroll to 'Midnight Boost.' It's yours. P.S. — If you want to unlock unlimited boost levels and save your own custom presets, Premium is waiting. But not today. Just enjoy the bonus.
